title: Up Ahead
overview: Seido takes on Norikane High as Sawamura struggles to live up to the weight of the team's ace number.

title: For the Team
overview: Ichidaisan High faces off against Yakushi, with Amahisa revealing a new pitch in his showdown with Raichi.

title: The Path of the Victor
overview: The showdown between Amahisa and Raichi kicks off the second half of the Yakushi-Ichidaisan match.

title: Roar
overview: Four quarterfinals matches play out as the semifinalists are decided.

title: Something Off
overview: Potential injuries plague both Seido and Ichidaisan, while Sawamura tries out new pitches.

title: The Unveiling
overview: Amahisa and Sawamura reveal a few new tricks to start the Ichidaisan-Seido match.

title: What's Built Up
overview: Ichidaisan and Seido continue to clash with no ground to spare in a tight match between ace pitchers.

title: The Mentality of the Ace
overview: The pressure builds on Sawamura as the Ichidaisan team brings out all its tricks to break the stalemate.

title: High Voltage
overview: The pitchers' duel continues as Seido struggles to make up for lost ground.

title: My Fight
overview: As late innings roll around, Seido seeks to break through Amahisa's ironclad pitching.

title: As a Partner
overview: One run behind in the eighth inning, the heart of Seido's order comes to the plate with a man on third.

title: The Next Stage
overview: After a dramatic turning point, Sawamura tries to get his last three outs of the game.
